reviews.t: What a value!
reviews.x: My shiseido curler's pad was split down the center! I didn't even think of looking here! For 6 pads it's a steal. I was so glad I found these. They are genuine; a perfect fit for my shiseido curler. What a difference! They're SO firm! My lashes looked fake almost - straight up to the sky visually opening the eye - and they're puny blonde and straight. In case you don't know this, as soon as you're done curling, use a *waterproof* mascara. Any old drugstore one. I don't know why, but waterproof s

reviews.t: Exactly Like U.S. Shiseido Lash Curler Replacements
reviews.x: Thank goodness Nordstrom and other retailers are not selling or are sold out of these Shiseido Lash Curler replacement pads because my desperation had me discover you can get 3x the amount for the same price by ordering this. It is exactly the same, high quality silicone pads that came with your Shiseido curler, and I know it also can be used with the Shu Uemura curlers because I did that for about 5 years until I decided to try the Shiseido curler. I find the Shiseido lash curler fits my eye sh

reviews.t: Fit well on my Sally Hansen curler
reviews.x: I bought this hoping it would fit and work well with my Sally Hensen eyelash curler. The item arrived on time and looked a little shorter than the one already on my curler. I was hesitant, but it adjusted to fit! I tried curling my lashes and it didn’t crimp oddly or shape lashes weird. It did pretty much what my usual curler does. So far, I’m continent. I’ll monitor how long each one last.

reviews.t: Love love love
reviews.x: They fit perfectly on my Revlon eye lash curler. They last for a long time. Haven't seen any dent or wear. Been using for a few months and still using the first set. Very high quality rubber. Doesn't cut your lashes either.

reviews.t: Cost effective, good for the environment!
reviews.x: These fit not only the Shiseido curler that I have, but another as well! I  tried to buy them at a make up store but was told they weren't even made. 🤔 let's keep the landfills down people!!

reviews.t: Not Shu Uemura, but a decent substitution
reviews.x: I purchased these for my Shu Uemura eyelash curler (like everyone else) since they do not sell refills. I love how many you get for such a low price. The quality is okay, but not quite the same as the Shu Uemura original one. It’s slightly firmer and slightly shorter. None of these are dealbreakers, especially since there isn’t actually an alternative, and I really don’t feel like spending $20 on a new curler every time they split (nor is that an economically friendly option). For the value, the

reviews.t: I feel like these pads don't curl my eyelashes as well as ...
reviews.x: These fit perfectly in the Shu Uemura eyelash curler. The price is unbeatable.  However, I feel like these pads don't curl my eyelashes as well as the original Shu Uemura pads. I am Asian and my eyelashes require quite a bit of squeezing to curl them. I found that I have to "train" them twice as much and twice as long with these pads. Due to this, I only gave them 4 stars.

reviews.t: Firmer and stronger
reviews.x: These rubber parts are firm and hold their shape well for a long time. The cheaper kind of replacement rubbers from other brands gets midline slits lengthwise easily after a while, but these are a lot tougher and last for quite long time. Thanks.

reviews.t: Perfect for your Shiseido curler
reviews.x: It is impossible to find these in stores. Instead of purchasing a brand new eyelash curler, I found these to fit my shiseido eyelash curler! Amazing. They are exactly the same as the one replacement they include with a new curler. Thankfully now I have 6 more replacements at a fraction of the price of buying a new curler. Thanks amazon!

reviews.t: Not exact fit but good enough
reviews.x: I bought these as replacement pads for my shu uemura curler since the pad was old and split in middle now. It’s not an exact dupe but good enough for my eyes! In the photos, the curler has the shiseido pad inserted with the gap pictured. The top pad is shiseido and bottom pad is the shu uemura one I replaced.

reviews.t: NOT AUTHENTIC
reviews.x: Does not fit my Shiseido eye curler, they are too small. These are NOT authentic. Do not be fooled. I purchased the correct refills for m ugh curler and they do not fit. I will order directly from Shiseido from now on. I cannot trust Amazon sellers to be truthful.

reviews.t: Fits my 20 year old Shu Uemura eyelash curler
reviews.x: Since Shu Uemura doesn’t sell refills of its silicone pads, I tried this one by Shisheido. Fits the Shu Uemura fine. It’s short by just a tiny bit, which I’m fine with and I just center it on the curler. Still achieved a nice curl

reviews.t: Fit a Shu Uemura Eyelash Curler
reviews.x: FINALLY!  These refills fit my Shu Uemura eyelash curler perfectly and IMHO are exactly the same rubber pads as those that came with my curler.

reviews.t: Replacement pads for the BEST eyelash curler!
reviews.x: I bought these as replacement pads for the world's best eye lash curler.  I love the Shiseido eyelash curler!!

reviews.t: Great Buy!
reviews.x: Fit both my old Shu Uemura eyelash curler and my Lancome eyelash curler. Six refills for less than $10!!

reviews.t: Does not fit on shu uemura eyelash curler
reviews.x: Doesn't fit on my shu uemura eyelash curler. Not happy!

reviews.t: Works for Shu Umera Eyelash Curler
reviews.x: I recently purchased these as a refill for the shu umera eyelash curler. Apparently they don't sell refill pads. These work, but don't quite fit all the way to the end of the eyelash curler, which isn't a problem for myself, but if you have wide eyes or eyelashes that extend to the very outer curler edge then be-aware the pad doesn't fill in the end. I also like the shu umera pads a little more as they feel a little firmer, but I can't notice a real difference in they way the shiseido pads curl,

reviews.t: Not A Perfect Fit for Shu Uemura
reviews.x: I was excited to read that these were a good fit for the shu uemura eyelash curler & at such a steal! I hate that you’re expected to buy an entirly new unit and she doesnt offer pad replacments, such a waste! I put a set in the day they arrived and while it works, they are NOT a perfect fit. They dont go all the way to the edge & leaves a large gap on either side of the bottom pad- I’ve got small eyes so its not a big deal but if you usually use the entire Shu Uemura pad area to pinch eyelashes

reviews.t: NOT AUTHENTIC!
reviews.x: I am pretty sure these are NOT AUTHENTIC SHISEIDO  products. Why? Because I put it in my SHISEIDO LASH CURLER, and the rubber pads are too short. It still fits inside, but the quality and results are HORRIBLE. The first week I used it, I didn't even realize that half my lashes had fallen out and they were all clumped and stuck to the metal part of the clamp! Horrifying sight & feeling. Do not purchase these based on the price -- you know what they say based on things that sound too good to be tr

reviews.t: Give these pads a try with your Shu Uemura Eyelash Curler. They do the job!
reviews.x: These eyelash curler replacement pads are a tad short for the Shu Uemura Eyelash Curler, but do a great job. The seller was quick to respond to my questions and honest about the slight difference in length. Shu Uemura is my go to curler, but does not sell replacement pads. You have to purchase another one of their curlers when two included pads wear out. These by Shiseido are great and reasonably priced.

reviews.t: Fits in a Shu Uemura lash curler but rubber seems harder, stiffer and cheaper.
reviews.x: I got these for my Shu Uemura lash curler since the replacement pads for those seem hard to get. I figured it should be pretty similar. The pads fit fine but are a lot harder than the Shu pads. The Shu pads I had were mat, not shiny and a lot softer. These are stiff and hard. I haven’t noticed any lashes being pulled out but they just don’t feel as nice. I wish I had looked harder for the Shu pads.

reviews.t: These ripped out my eyelashes,Do NOT BUY
reviews.x: I put these in my Shiseido eyelash curler and used it as normal. This pulled out my eyelashes, not from the root , but it basically cut my eyelashes at the root. I am extremely upset. It first happened and I thought maybe I did something wrong. So I switched the orientation. Then it happened again this time cutting off like 20 of my eyelashes, leaving only the root of my eyelash. DO NOT BUY!!

reviews.t: Great Product
reviews.x: This is my second purchase of these rubber replacements for my Shu Uemura eye lash curler. It fits & works perfectly. It has renewed my curler and works like new.  No excessive lash crimping or pulling.  I have 2 additional replacements for the future. I would recommend & purchase again for the cost!

reviews.t: Not great
reviews.x: I bought these as refills for my Shu Uemra curler since reviews said it fits. It really doesn't go all the way from end to end so now I'm getting strange crimps in more corner lashes. They also don't curl nearly as well as the pad that came with my Shu Uemra curler. I will likely be returning them.

reviews.t: Buy in Bulk
reviews.x: So happy to find these refills on Amazon.  They can be hard to find in the stores and they are the authentic Shiseido brand and fit the eyelash curler perfectly.  I love that you get so many in a package, so I don't have to look for them or re-order right away.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value, noting you get many pads (often six) for a low price.
Many customers report these pads fit their Shiseido curlers well and match the original quality.
Several reviewers say the pads also fit other brands, including Shu Uemura, Revlon, Sally Hansen, and Lancome curlers.
Some customers find the pads firmer or slightly shorter than the originals, which can affect curling performance.
A few reviewers report fit or authenticity problems, with one saying the pads were too small and not genuine.
